frame: chair frame mm (solve/metric_frame.json): +X chair's right, +Y forward, +Z up, table top Z=0
design_intent: symmetric about X=0: right-half dots mirrored

tps.formula: z = sum_i w[i]*r_i^2*ln(r_i) + a[0] + a[1]*x + a[2]*y,  r_i = |(x,y) - centre_i| in mm

outline_cloud.note: approximate seat edge |x| per y from the chair cloud (98th pct of points near rim height)

rim.definition: z_rim(y) = max over x of the fitted surface at station y (dotted region)
